configuration_notes.adzuna: Set ADZUNA_APP_ID and ADZUNA_APP_KEY. Search snapshots are bounded samples, never a census or evidence that missing jobs closed.
configuration_notes.jsonld: Add an enabled source with adapter=jsonld, name, approved=true, urls=[approved HTTPS JobPosting detail URLs]. robots.txt is checked before fetching. Listing-page discovery is intentionally not implemented.
configuration_notes.rss: Add an enabled source with adapter=rss, name, approved=true, url=approved HTTPS RSS/Atom feed, country_code=NL. Feed entries rarely include salary/company; missing values remain null. No linked pages are fetched.
configuration_notes.approval: approved=true records the operator's permission to collect a publisher's feed/pages; robots allowance alone does not grant reuse rights. Check source terms before enabling.
